_purpose: The websites database: every site the Browser page (native) and web.html (web mirror) offer, one record each, with whether its pages may legally be shown INSIDE HumanityOS (the readable web view today, in-world screens next) and any affiliate relationship. Schema: schemas/web_sites.toml. Checked by scripts/check-web-sites.js (unique ids, http(s) URLs, status enum, a decided status needs its evidence, our own domains allowed). Design: docs/design/readable-web.md.
_workflow: embed.status starts at needs_review. It leaves that state only when a person reads the site's terms and records basis (the clause), terms_url, reviewed_on (ISO date) and reviewed_by. affiliate.tag stays null until a programme is joined; when it is set, affiliate.disclosure is shown above every page of that site. Nothing here decides legality; it records the decision a human made.
